name: STICKEE | Grape Gas | 1G | Live Resin Disposable
description: Meet Grape Gas: Sweet on the Lips. Gas on the Exhale. Grape Gas is what happens when a fruit stand and a gas station fall in love. One puff and you’re hit with juicy, candy-sweet grape on the inhale, followed by a pungent, gassy exhale that slaps harder than a mixtape drop at 2 a.m. It’s smooth, it’s funky, and it’s got that “why does this taste so good and so wrong at the same time” vibe that keeps you coming back for more. This cart doesn’t whisper—it shouts. Big flavor. Bold clouds. And a high that revs the engine, shifts gears, and leaves you cruising somewhere between “dancing in the kitchen” and “dozing off on the couch.” Sweet meets diesel. Purple meets power. It’s Grape Gas, and it’s running the flavor game on premium octane.
